**P1 — Validate every victim retry's lifecycle**

Only the selected request is checked here. Other request IDs are merely drained, which permits `ROOT_EXIT`/`TASK_EXIT` after `WRAPPER_RETURN`; a retry can therefore reproduce the early-return defect without failing this case. After quiescence, run `assert_lifecycle` over every observed victim request (using the stubborn residual allowance where appropriate) and add a retry-return-before-root-exit regression test.
